items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: He played with what a Sphinx fan when we was in Memphis at Silver Slipper.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: And you played with, what do you call him? Borgie Shalane? Well, he was a drummer.
He killed himself. He killed himself about six months ago. He played with what a Sphinx fan when we was in Memphis at Silver Slipper.
Who were some of the good drummers there?
